hosting.//: Pin the deploy target by site name. With the project pinned in .firebaserc as well, `firebase deploy` cannot land on another site that happens to be the default in the active project.

headers.//: `**`, not `**/*.html`: header rules match the request path, and cleanUrls means the pages are served from /privacy rather than /privacy.html, so an extension-based pattern silently matches nothing.

headers.value: default-src 'none'; style-src 'self'; img-src 'self'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'
